title: 5-Year Treasury Note auction (December new issue) — the schedule's only doubled coupon session, sold on one session of when-issued trading
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), RE-FETCHED direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream into 909 tokens — NOT carried from either proposing sweep's transcription. Row reads verbatim `5-Year  NOTE / Thursday, December 24, 2026 / Monday, December 28, 2026 / Thursday, December 31, 2026` (announcement / auction / settlement) with NO trailing `R`, so a new issue — consistent with the whole fiscaldata record, on which no nominal 5-Year auction is a reopening. The flag column IS populated elsewhere in the same December block (`2-Year  FRN R`, `20-Year  BOND R`, `5-Year  TIPS R T`, all announced 12-17), so the blank is a signal rather than a missing field, and the `5-Year  TIPS R T` row auctioning 12-22 is a different security. The same fetch carries the schedule's own holiday line `Holiday - Friday, December 25, 2026 - Christmas Day`. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. STAYS ESTIMATE on the two limits this lane records at D-110: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and the confirming primary is the 2026-12-24 announcement itself, 106 days out. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), after reading BOTH prior proposals per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md: `proposals/treasury-5y-note-2026-12-28.from-treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29.json` and `proposals/treasury-5y-note-2026-12-28.from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-12-24.json` (both 2026-09-09). They agree on date, kind, impact and estimate status; this file adopts neither title verbatim because both name the doubled session and neither names the when-issued compression this research found to be the sharper structural fact. Both proposals stay where they are and are now shadowed. THE BLOCK, read off the schedule this session: 2-Year NOTE and 5-Year NOTE both auction Monday 2026-12-28 (with the 13-week and 26-week bills), the 7-Year NOTE auctions Tuesday 2026-12-29 (with the 6-week bill), all six announced Thursday 2026-12-24 and all six settling Thursday 2026-12-31, the last business day of the year. SIZE IS UNPUBLISHED TODAY and is not asserted here: `sb0590` (2026-08-05) read direct this session (HTTP 200, 75,577 bytes) publishes an anticipated-size grid running `May-26 Jun-26 Jul-26 Aug-26 Sep-26 Oct-26` and STOPS — the 5-Year column reads 70 in all six rows, but there is no November or December row anywhere in the release. $70B is an EXPECTATION from 28 consecutive $70B prints (2024-04-24 -> 2026-08-26, fiscaldata, zero deviations) plus the release's verbatim guidance that Treasury 'anticipates maintaining nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes for at least the next several quarters'; the published figure arrives at the 2026-11-04 refunding. THE FINDING THAT EARNS THIS EVENT ITS LEDGER — DECEMBER IS THE MONTH THE 5-YEAR AUCTION-DAY CURVE DIP RUNS THE OTHER WAY, AND IT IS NOT THE FAR-FROM-FOMC CUT IN DISGUISE. Measured this session across 290 nominal 5-Year auctions inside curve coverage against 7,176 par-curve sessions (1998-01-02 -> 2026-09-08, both pulled today): the 5Y-minus-avg(3Y,7Y) auction-day move runs +0.705bp in December (n=22, t=+1.71) against -0.526bp in the other eleven months (n=268, t=-4.74), and only 3 of 22 Decembers clear the -1.0bp threshold the sibling ledgers grade on, against 97 of 268 elsewhere. Paired within-year — each December against its OWN year's January-November mean, the design that removes the era confound and the one the 7-Year sibling validated — the gap is +0.960bp (n=22, t=+2.71, sign-flip permutation p = 0.0096 on 100k draws, 15 of 22 positive); excluding 2008's crisis print it is +0.740bp (t=+2.55, p = 0.019). THE DECISIVE TEST, because December and 'far from FOMC' are nearly collinear and the 11-24 sibling reads far-from-FOMC as the STRONGER population (-2.00bp, t=-7.50): inside the fully-parsed 1998-2019 window (174 FOMC decision dates from the Fed's own current and historical calendars, 212 auctions, 44 near-FOMC at +/-3 sessions), far-from-FOMC non-December auctions print -0.279bp (n=154, t=-1.89) while far-from-FOMC DECEMBER auctions print +1.214bp (n=14, t=+2.22) — Welch t = +2.64 on the difference. So the December shallowing is orthogonal to the FOMC cut and runs against it, and 2026-12-28 being D+19 from fomc-2026-12-09 and D-30 from fomc-2027-01-27 does NOT license the deeper prior. SECOND FINDING — THE WHEN-ISSUED WINDOW IS ONE SESSION, THE SHORTEST THIS TENOR HAS EVER SOLD ON IN THE MODERN SIZE ERA, AND IT IS MEASURED NOT TO COST DEMAND. Counted on Treasury's own published-session calendar, the 12-24 announcement is followed by the Christmas Day closure and then the auction, so exactly one session separates them; only 3 of 290 5-Year auctions since 1998 have had that (2005-09-07, 2005-10-12 and 2020-12-28), and only the last is post-2010. Pooling one-session-window auctions across the 2Y/3Y/5Y/7Y/10Y coupon population (n=9 of 1,132) gives a bid-to-cover z of -0.765 against +0.027 elsewhere, t = -1.34 — NOT significant, and the composition is split (2010-12-27 printed z +1.69). December dealer takedown paired against its own year's January-November mean is likewise a clean null at this tenor: -0.164 percentage points (n=17, t=-0.08, 5 of 17 above), corroborating the 7-Year sibling's year-end balance-sheet null at a second tenor. THIRD — THE DOUBLED SESSION DOES NOT DILUTE THE CURVE MEASURE, and the mechanical worry that it might is refuted directly. In 2023+ the 5-Year prints -1.600bp (n=10, t=-4.82) when a 2-Year NOTE sells in the same session against -1.712bp (n=33, t=-8.48) when it sells alone; and the same-day 2-Year does not drag the 3-Year leg of the denominator, which is the channel that would have biased the measure toward zero — the 3Y-minus-7Y spread change on 2-Year auction days is +0.211bp (t=+1.52, n=331) full-record and +0.186bp (t=+0.52, n=43) in 2023+, against +0.012bp and +0.044bp on no-auction sessions. THE DIRECT PRECEDENT is 2020-12-28, a row-for-row calendar twin (Thursday 12-24 announcement, 2Y and 5Y both Monday 12-28, 7Y Tuesday 12-29, settle Thursday 12-31, identical late-December weekdays): it printed a relative move of +1.50bp — a MISS on the -1.0bp threshold — with bid-to-cover 2.39 and dealer takedown 24.92% on $59B.
